scope: One existing train-group advance history at tick 168. Add one snapshot with three signed timing pairs and two nominal replays, then use it in a later training-data-only comparison. This document freezes the capture scope for static preflight.
sequence_rule: Copy the three exact direction sequences from the hash-pinned reference design. Add the signed amplitude to the selected training episode's own nominal requests. Keep the absolute tick-184 release and complete H32 paths.
initialization: Execute the original advance control prefix once in deterministic Newton from its pinned train initial state and save a new native snapshot. Restore both state buffers and controller state independently per branch. The older archive establishes provenance and static controller evidence. It does not supply the new deterministic ball state.

gates.provenance: Require exact case, training split, runtime, source hashes, original control history, controller limits and snapshot layout. Bind static command evidence before launching a physics worker.
gates.nominal: Both complete same-session nominal branches pass the original timing capture gate before any perturbation. Compare exact requested and executed controls, timing and retention classification, component ceilings of 1e-5 m, 1e-3 m/s, 2e-2 rad/s and position half-spread <=1e-6 m at H8/H16/H24/H32.
gates.signed: Require complete transitions and the existing signed shared H1-H8 pitch pulse/reversal gate. Save pair/noise eligibility and measured position, velocity and spin response vectors. Publish the train-only supplement manifest after all eight branches and checks complete. Keep partial artifacts outside the training manifest.

stop_conditions: Hash, training identity, deterministic runtime, static control, snapshot restore or nominal gate mismatch
Any invalid or incomplete transition, shared-prefix check failure or resource cap
Fixed eight-branch scope complete. No automatic retry or substitution of case, direction, seed, amplitude or tick.

subsequent_fit.scope: Data-only comparison of the accepted 49 train pairs against the frozen 46-pair dense-velocity endpoint. Freeze its execution and resource plan after capture acceptance.
subsequent_fit.pair_weighting: Keep all frozen group and episode/tick cell totals. Split the selected training episode/tick cell equally over its original held offsets and the three new timing pairs, preserving all other cell weights.
subsequent_fit.evaluation: Reuse the original 46-pair nominal error upper bound, frozen three timing validation directions, and the 40-pair legacy protection gates. Report improvement relative to the dense-velocity endpoint. Keep development validation and test splits out of training.
